messages:
alex: Quick boarding-pass sync for tomorrow's release train — need to lock slots, smoke owners, and rollback plan. Who's taking the 09:00 PDT slot? Services: model-router, inference-api, console. Please reply with 'slot: service — smoke owner — rollback-owner' or react :thumbsup: once claimed.

maya: I'll take 09:00 — model-router. Smoke owner: maya. Rollback: jasper. I'll run the post-deploy smoke (health + qps smoke).

jasper: Ack. I'm the fallback rollback owner for model-router. If anything looks off, revert to v2.3.1 and open PR rollback-runbook.

tom: I can take 10:30 for inference-api. Smoke owner: tom. Rollback-owner: tom. ETA deploy window 10:30-11:00.

alex: Here's the minimal boarding pass snippet (for console copy):
```
- slot: 09:00
  service: model-router
  smoke_owner: maya
  rollback_owner: jasper
- slot: 10:30
  service: inference-api
  smoke_owner: tom
  rollback_owner: tom
- slot: 11:45
  service: console
  smoke_owner: jasper
  rollback_owner: maya
```

jasper: I'll take 11:45 for console smoke. Quick note: console has a DB migration — plan is zero-downtime, but keep 15-min monitor before next slot.

tom: quick q — who runs the smoke-run command? is it in runbooks/deploy/smoke.sh? I can run it but need exact commands.

alex: Runbooks path: /runbooks/releases/smoke-checklist.md. Quick commands: `./smoke.sh --service model-router --short` — I'll paste the checklist in a thread in ops later.

maya: :thumbsup: all set for 09:00. I'll also run a perf sanity that takes ~2 mins.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 09:00 model-router (maya) — if you need to move, ping @alex by EOD. Good luck :rocket:
